Type:        DATA_GENERATOR
Name:        DataGenerator
Category:    readers
Description: Generates data records according to defined pattern and sends them to all connected output ports.
Usage:       When to use: Generate synthetic or patterned records for testing, iteration, simulation, or driving repeated downstream operations without an external input source.

Output Ports:
  [*] (min 1 required)

Properties:
  generate [attr-cdata]: [transformGenerator]  Configures generator.
  generateURL: [file]  Specifies the path or URL for generator url.
  generateClass: [class]  Configures generator class.
  charset: [charset]  Defines the character encoding used to encode/decode file content. If not specified, the system will attempt to detect or use the default encoding.
  recordsNumber: [dataGeneratorRecordNumber]  (default: 1)  Controls the number of number of records to generate to process.
  pattern: [recordPattern]  Configures record pattern.
  randomFields: [key]  Configures random fields.
  sequenceFields: [sequenceMapping]  Configures sequence fields.
  randomSeed: [long]  Configures random seed.

To configure it, call component_get_guide("DATA_GENERATOR") — full attribute reference with allowed values, defaults, and worked mapping/transform examples this surface view omits. Don't re-run component_get_info on the same type; if the properties above aren't enough, escalate to component_get_guide.
